management_steps.details: Cool running water over burn for 20 mins if < 3 hours old. Clean wound, remove all blisters and debris. Estimate TBSA% using Lund and Browder chart.

Resuscitate with Ringers Lactate/Balsol if TBSA > 20% (adult) or > 15% (paeds): 2ml x TBSA% x Weight (kg). Infuse half in the first 8 hours, and the remainder over the next 16 hours. Target urine output: Adults 0.5-1 ml/kg/hr, Paeds 1-2 ml/kg/hr.
Indications: circumferential burns with vascular compromise (loss of distal pulse, severe pain, cyanosis). Incise deep along axial lines into subcutaneous tissue to breach constricting fascia.
